payload.title: updateHRDepartment rewrites a unit's moduleCode while employees are placed in it, and employees take their module only through their unit, so one edit silently moves every placed employee into another module's slice without a duty request or HR approval
evidence: apps/hr-service/src/hr/handlers/update-department.handler.ts:74-76 (every input field, moduleCode included, is applied with Object.assign)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/handlers/update-department.handler.ts:58-68 (placed employees are counted only for a soft delete, never for a module change)
apps/hr-service/src/common/module-scope.ts:4-8 (an employee has no module of their own, only a department)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/hr.resolver.ts:314-316 (updateHRDepartment is open to any global MODULE_MANAGER)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/dto/update-department.input.ts:48-51 (moduleCode is an ordinary optional update field)
payload.rule_violated: D5: module managers request duty inside their module and HR approves, so an employee's module membership changes only through that approval
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-18, release R7.
